junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.about-dolly:
There's something you should know. Dolly didn't take kindly to my decision. She's said nothing to my face, but I've seen that look before - she thinks I've gone soft. Maybe worse.

If you want this peace to hold, you might want to go talk to her yourself. She listens to reason better than she listens to orders. Tread carefully - but don't wait too long, either.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.about-dolly-ack: I'll keep an eye on her.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.about-dolly-repeat: Just… watch yourself around Dolly, if you can. I'd rather not have to choose between her and this peace.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.negociations/agreed: …Fine. You've made your point, more than once. I'll allow it - a relationship with the surface, tested carefully, one step at a time. Go on, then. Tell them the diamond dogs are willing to talk.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.negociations/debate-entry:
Relationship ? With the surface ?

My wounded dogs got better thanks to you. I won't forget that. But one act of kindness doesn't undo generations of misdeeds. I don't see what good could come from opening our door to your kind.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.negociations/argue-bandits-help: Junkville marched down here and fought the bandits shoulder to shoulder with your pack. That's not nothing.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.negociations/argue-future: You can't keep the surface out forever, Fido. Better to build something on your own terms now, than have it forced on you later.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.negociations/argue-need-help: Your pack needed outside help before - remember the wounded dogs ? You didn't turn it down then.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.negociations/debate-continue: Back again ? Go on, then. Convince me, if you think you still can.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.negociations/debate-leave: I'll leave you to think about it.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.negociations/point-bandits-made: No. It's not. I still don't fully understand why they'd bleed for dogs they'd never met… but they did. That counts for something, I'll grant you that.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.negociations/point-future-made: …You're not wrong. Sooner or later, the surface finds its way down here, one way or another. Better it be a hand extended than a blade.
junkville/dogs/leader-negociation.negociations/point-help-made: We did. And I'm not made of stone - I remember who came when we needed it. But needing help once doesn't mean opening our home to strangers forever.
